Review findings:
- [Layout > grid-item-fill] BookCard grid row 1 (desktop, default 6-book fixture): cards do not fill their grid cells vertically. 'The Overstory' (short title, single line) is ~40px shorter than 'Tomorrow, and Tomorrow, and Tomorrow' (title wraps to 3 lines). Bottom edges do not align — the short card's bottom falls well above the tall card's bottom, producing a ragged row. The grid container or card elements are missing `align-items: stretch` (or equivalent), causing cards to size to content rather than filling the cell height. Fix: ensure the grid sets `align-items: stretch` (the CSS default) and that each BookCard uses `height: 100%` so the card element expands to match the tallest sibling in the row.
